slug: 2025-12-15 Strengthening Civil Registration and Ending Statelessness in South Sudan

facts.fact: Anecdotal estimates say only about 10% of South Sudan's roughly 12 million people hold Nationality Certificates (about 1.2 million, share as stated), and the country has yet to issue National ID cards at scale, per Hold the Child.
